title: Recording: Steel And Glass, Old Dirt Road by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon recorded two songs for his Walls And Bridges album on 20 July 1974.

The backing tracks for ‘Steel And Glass’ and ‘Old Dirt Road’ were both recorded during this session. Both songs were completed on 22 August.
